name: grafana_manage
description: Manage Grafana resources including dashboards, annotations, alert rules, folders, and data sources via the Grafana HTTP API.
usage_guidance: Use this tool for all Grafana operations: dashboard CRUD, annotation management, alert rule provisioning, folder organization, and dashboard search. Read operations (get, list, search, export) are autonomous. Write operations (create, update, delete dashboards and alert rules) require human confirmation. Always use dashboard UIDs rather than numeric IDs. Include folder_uid when creating/updating dashboards to control placement.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The Grafana management action to perform.

parameters.name: --uid
parameters.description: Dashboard UID, alert rule UID, or folder UID for get/update/delete operations.

parameters.name: --dashboard_json
parameters.description: Full dashboard JSON model for create/update operations. For create: set id to null. For update: include current version number.

parameters.name: --folder_uid
parameters.description: Target folder UID for dashboard placement or folder operations.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.description: Search query string for dashboard_search, or PromQL expression for datasource_proxy_query.

parameters.name: --tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated tags for filtering (dashboard_search) or annotation creation. Multiple tags use AND logic.

parameters.name: --from
parameters.description: Start time in epoch milliseconds for annotation_list, or ISO timestamp for time-bounded operations.

parameters.name: --to
parameters.description: End time in epoch milliseconds for annotation_list, or ISO timestamp for time-bounded operations.

parameters.name: --text
parameters.description: Annotation text content for annotation_create/update. Supports HTML.

parameters.name: --dashboard_id
parameters.description: Dashboard numeric ID for scoping annotations to a specific dashboard.

parameters.name: --panel_id
parameters.description: Panel ID for scoping annotations to a specific panel within a dashboard.

parameters.name: --annotation_id
parameters.description: Annotation ID for update/delete operations.

parameters.name: --alert_rule_json
parameters.description: Full alert rule JSON (ProvisionedAlertRule schema) for alert_rules_create/update operations.

parameters.name: --rule_group
parameters.description: Alert rule group name for group-level operations.

parameters.name: --export_format
parameters.description: Export format for alert_rules_export action.

parameters.name: --message
parameters.description: Version history commit message for dashboard create/update operations.

parameters.name: --overwrite
parameters.description: Force overwrite on UID/title collision for dashboard create/update.

parameters.name: --datasource_uid
parameters.description: Data source UID for datasource_get or datasource_proxy_query operations.

parameters.name: --org_id
parameters.description: Organization ID sent via X-Grafana-Org-Id header. Defaults to org 1.

parameters.name: --limit
parameters.description: Maximum results for list/search operations.

parameters.name: --endpoint
parameters.description: Grafana API base URL. Defaults to GRAFANA_URL environment variable.

returns: JSON object with operation-specific response data. Dashboard operations return uid, url, status, version. Annotation operations return id and message. Alert rule operations return the ProvisionedAlertRule object. Search returns array of matching items.
